description: This source file provides utility functions for Linux network interface management, including retrieving and setting interface states, MAC addresses, interface indices, as well as handling VLANs and lower interface relations. It includes functions for network socket creation, interface flag manipulation, and vendor identification based on driver paths.

methods.name: int s_getIfFlags(int sock,char * intfName,uint16_t * pIntfFlags)
methods.description: Retrieves network interface flags for the specified interface using ioctl.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getState(int sock,char * intfName)
methods.description: Checks if the specified interface is up.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getStateExt(char * intfName)
methods.description: Checks if the specified interface is up, creating a socket to do so.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getLinkState(int sock,char * intfName)
methods.description: Checks if the link of the specified interface is active.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getLinkStateExt(char * intfName)
methods.description: Checks link state with socket creation.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_setState(int sock,char * intfName,int state)
methods.description: Sets the administrative state of the network interface (up/down).

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_setStateExt(char * intfName,int state)
methods.description: Sets interface state by creating a socket.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_setMac(int sock,char * intfName,swl_macBin_t * macInfo)
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the interface.

methods.description: Sets MAC address with socket.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getMac(int sock,char * intfName,swl_macBin_t * macInfo)
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the interface.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getMacExt(char * intfName,swl_macBin_t * macInfo)
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address with socket.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getIfIndex(int sock,char * intfName,int * pIfIndex)
methods.description: Gets the index of the interface.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_getIfIndexExt(char * intfName,int * pIfIndex)
methods.description: Gets interface index with socket.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_updateMac(int sock,char * intfName,swl_macBin_t * macAddress)
methods.description: Updates the MAC address if different from current, toggling interface down if needed.

methods.name: int wld_linuxIfUtils_updateMacExt(char * intfName,swl_macBin_t * macAddress)
methods.description: Updates MAC address with socket.

methods.description: Identifies the chipset vendor based on driver path.

methods.description: Gets lower interfaces linked to the specified interface.

methods.description: Gets the lower interface for a VLAN interface.

methods.name: bool wld_linuxIfUtils_inBridge(char * intfName)
